DESCRIPTION.Modules: Python module filenames available in the selection menu. Maintain the module list here; adding a filename requires no constants change.
DESCRIPTION.ModuleFolder: Shared directory containing all configured Python modules. Status reports whether each configured module file exists.
DESCRIPTION.CheckFolders: Shared additional folders recursively scanned for references to functions in the selected module.
DESCRIPTION.CheckFiles: Shared individual Python files scanned for references to functions in the selected module.
